cards.ex: Let's brainstorm some ideas for the new marketing campaign.
cards.exUz: Keling, yangi marketing kampaniyasi uchun bir nechta fikrlar to'plam qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Yangi fikrlar yaratish uchun guruh bo'lib muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va odatiy bo'lmagan usulda fikrlash.

cards.ex: Visiting the museum sparked my imagination and gave me lots of new ideas.
cards.exUz: Muzeyga tashrif buyurish mening tasavvurimni uyg'otdi va menga juda ko'p yangi g'oyalar berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa tasavvurni ishga solishga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Painting is a great creative outlet for me after a stressful day.
cards.exUz: Rasm chizish men uchun stressli kundan keyin ajoyib ijodiy ifoda usuli hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy qobiliyatni namoyon qilish usuli (masalan, rasm chizish).

cards.ex: The artist is known for pushing the boundaries of modern art.
cards.exUz: Rassom zamonaviy san'atning chegaralarini kengaytirish bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud chegaralarni buzib o'tish yoki kengaytirish.

cards.ex: He came up with a brilliant idea for the project.
cards.exUz: U loyiha uchun ajoyib g'oya o'ylab topdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi fikr, reja yoki yechimni o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: Just imagine the possibilities if we invest in this technology!
cards.exUz: Agar biz ushbu texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritsak, imkoniyatlarni tasavvur qiling!
cards.uzDef: Nima bo'lishi mumkinligini o'ylab ko'rish, xayol qilish.

cards.ex: The monster under the bed was just a figment of my imagination.
cards.exUz: Krovat ostidagi maxluq faqat mening fantaziyam mevasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotda yo'q narsa, faqat tasavvurda mavjud bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: You need to be able to think on your feet in this job.
cards.exUz: Bu ishda siz tez fikrlay olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan vaziyatda tez va samarali fikrlash.

cards.ex: The music really got my creative juices flowing.
cards.exUz: Musiqa haqiqatan ham mening ijodiy ilhomimni uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy fikrlash va yaratishga tayyor bo'lish holati.

cards.ex: She has an outside-the-box approach to problem-solving.
cards.exUz: U muammolarni hal qilishda g'ayrioddiy yondashuvga ega.
cards.uzDef: Standart yoki odatiy bo'lmagan usulda fikrlash.

cards.ex: The company is known for its innovative approach to product development.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mahsulot ishlab chiqishga innovatsion yondashuvi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va samarali yondashuv yoki usul.

cards.ex: Her designs are full of originality and flair.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynlari o'ziga xoslik va uslubga to'la.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xos va chiroyli uslubda yaratish.

cards.ex: Just close your eyes and let your imagination run wild!
cards.exUz: Faqat ko'zingizni yuming va tasavvuringizga erkinlik bering!
cards.uzDef: Cheklovlarsiz tasavvur qilishga ruxsat berish.

cards.ex: We need to think creatively to overcome these challenges.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu qiyinchiliklarni engish uchun ijodiy fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va o'ziga xos usulda fikrlash.

cards.ex: He is considered a visionary leader in the tech industry.
cards.exUz: U texnologiya sohasida ko'ruvchan lider hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni oldindan ko'ra oladigan lider.

cards.ex: She dreamed up the whole story in her head.
cards.exUz: U butun hikoyani o'zining xayolida keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va kutilmagan narsani tasavvur qilish yoki o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: It was a stroke of genius to combine those two ideas.
cards.exUz: Ushbu ikkita g'oyani birlashtirish daholik alomati edi.
cards.uzDef: Birdan paydo bo'lgan ajoyib fikr yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: I get inspired by traveling to new places.
cards.exUz: Men yangi joylarga sayohat qilishdan ilhomlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan ilhom olish yoki ruhlanish.

cards.ex: The director took some artistic license with the historical details.
cards.exUz: Direktor tarixiy tafsilotlar bilan biroz badiiy erkinlik oldi.
cards.uzDef: Factlardan biroz chekinish uchun berilgan erkinlik.

cards.ex: The workshop helps people unleash their creativity.
cards.exUz: Seminar odamlarga o'zlarining ijodlarini ochishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy qobiliyatlarni to'liq namoyon qilishga imkon berish.

cards.ex: The company values out-of-the-box thinking.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya standartdan tashqari fikrlashni qadrlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Nodatiy va original usullar bilan fikrlash.

cards.ex: Stop building castles in the air and focus on reality.
cards.exUz: Havoda saroy qurishni to'xtating va haqiqatga e'tibor qarating.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan narsalar haqida orzu qilish.

cards.ex: We need to generate new ideas for the product launch.
cards.exUz: Biz mahsulotni ishga tushirish uchun yangi g'oyalar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi fikrlar va g'oyalar yaratish.

cards.ex: She has a very creative mind and comes up with great ideas.
cards.exUz: U juda ijodkor aqlga ega va ajoyib g'oyalar bilan chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy va original fikrlash qobiliyatiga ega bo'lgan aql.

cards.ex: You have to dare to dream if you want to achieve great things.
cards.exUz: Agar siz buyuk narsalarga erishmoqchi bo'lsangiz, orzu qilishga jur'at etishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Katta va qiyin orzularni amalga oshirishga urinish.

cards.ex: Don't be afraid to think big and aim for the stars.
cards.exUz: Katta o'ylashdan va yulduzlarga intilishdan qo'rqmang.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadlar qo'yish va ularga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Use your imagination to come up with a solution to the problem.
cards.exUz: Muammoni hal qilish uchun tasavvuringizdan foydalaning.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvur qobiliyatidan foydalanib, yangi narsalarni o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: The company encourages innovative thinking among its employees.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z xodimlari orasida innovatsion fikrlashni rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va samarali usullarni topishga qaratilgan fikrlash.

cards.ex: Reading books can fuel the imagination and expand your horizons.
cards.exUz: Kitob o'qish tasavvurni oziqlantirishi va ufqingizni kengaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurni yangi fikrlar va ilhom bilan to'ldirish.
